subject.title: [Feature]: Expose sessionKey/runId to outbound message hook for deterministic verification

question: What bounded evidence contract should OpenClaw expose to pre-send plugin hooks for deterministic verification?
rationale: Current main has sessionKey and adjacent reply_payload_sending run/usage support, but exposing runId plus transcript/tool-call/tool-result evidence broadens the public Plugin SDK and sensitive session-data access.

options.title: Design bounded evidence view
options.body: Specify minimal redacted run/session/evidence fields with size, redaction, and permission rules before implementation.

options.title: Use reply_payload_sending as verification surface
options.body: Declare reply_payload_sending plus existing run context as the supported pre-send API and narrow this issue to missing evidence or docs gaps there.

options.title: Fold into broader trace or policy work
options.body: Make the broader trace/outbound policy tracker canonical if maintainers want one unified API before any narrower implementation.

recommendation.title: Design bounded evidence view
recommendation.body: Specify minimal redacted run/session/evidence fields with size, redaction, and permission rules before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and reviewed the closest prior outbound hook changes and are the clearest routing owner for the API/security decision.
